name: NOIRLab Astro Data Lab TAP Service
summary: ADQL queries over large astronomical survey catalogues (DES DR1/DR2, DELVE, DECaPS, Legacy Surveys, DESI, Euclid Q1, Gaia, AllWISE, CatWISE and more) through an anonymous TAP service.
description: Data Lab's TAP endpoint lists more than 90 schemas in tap_schema.schemas, including des_dr2 (Dark Energy Survey DR2), delve_dr1 to dr3, decaps_dr2, desi_dr1, euclid_q1, gaia_dr3, allwise, catwise2020 and the DECam Asteroid Database. des_dr2.main held 691,483,608 rows on 2026-11-13. Anonymous use is limited to synchronous queries of public datasets.

auth.notes: Anonymous access covers synchronous queries of public datasets; everything else (async jobs, MyDB, storage) needs a free Data Lab account.

rate_limit.summary: Not documented in the pages fetched.

endpoints.summary: Synchronous ADQL query; FORMAT csv, tsv or votable
VOSI table listing (very large; the call did not finish within 120 s)

license.name: Not stated on the pages checked; acknowledge Astro Data Lab and the survey, as each survey's Data Lab page requests

coverage.geographic: Per survey (DES covers about 5,000 square degrees of the southern sky)

agent_notes: List what exists with SELECT schema_name,description FROM tap_schema.schemas (about 2 s), then tables with tap_schema.tables WHERE schema_name='des_dr2'. Qualify tables as schema.table. Use FORMAT=csv; the service cannot return JSON. TOP n is required for quick tests because the tables hold hundreds of millions of rows. Cone searches use q3c_radial_query or the standard CONTAINS/CIRCLE.
caveats: FORMAT=json returned HTTP 200 with a VOTable whose QUERY_STATUS is ERROR ('unknown format: json'), so check the body, not the status.
No Access-Control-Allow-Origin header was sent, so browsers on other origins cannot call it directly.
The TAP capabilities document lists http://datalab.noirlab.edu/ivoa-dal/tap/ access URLs that differ from the working https://datalab.noirlab.edu/tap/ base.
Row limits, rate limits and a licence were not found in the documentation pages fetched.
The example took 1.9 to 7.9 s across runs on 2026-11-13.

verification.notes: Exact example request executed without credentials.
